 About Australia vs Afghanistan Final
 The Australia vs Afghanistan Final in the HK Sixes, 2026 delivered an exciting contest at Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok on 01 November 2026, with both teams showcasing strong performances with bat and ball. Batting first, Australia put up 115/5 (6.0) on the board, thanks to a solid knock from Max Bryant, who scored 44 runs, while Alex Ross provided valuable support. In reply, Afghanistan fought hard and reached 119/2 (5.1), with Imran Mir leading the chase with an important contribution. With the ball, Karim Janat and Patrick Dooley made a significant impact by picking up crucial wickets and controlling the run flow at key moments. This stats page gives fans a complete breakdown of batting and bowling performances, partnerships, strike rates, economy rates, and key match moments from the HK Sixes, 2026, helping readers understand how the game unfolded.
